title: Warm Cassata Bread Pudding with Berries
description: A delicious dessert made with warm bread, Italian cassata, and fresh berries. Perfect for a cozy evening or a special occasion.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the cubed bread and cassata to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Pour in the heavy cream and mix until the bread is evenly soaked.
Add the mixed berries and ground allspice to the bowl and mix until they're evenly distributed.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
